Reviewer: The 6 extra PCR cycles required at higher RT temperatures (p6) is a significant amount of extra amplification. 
Does this lead to reduced library complexity or higher UMI duplication rates?

# Without Downsampling
i would not trust that, so integrated downsampling below
```{r}
# Load UMI and read count matrices for each condition
umis_M42 <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(readRDS(here("data/RTase/counts/Maxima_42.dgecounts.rds"))$umicount$inex$all))
umis_M50 <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(readRDS(here("data/RTase/counts/Maxima_50.dgecounts.rds"))$umicount$inex$all))
umis_S42 <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(readRDS(here("data/RTase/counts/SS_42.dgecounts.rds"))$umicount$inex$all))
umis_S50 <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(readRDS(here("data/RTase/counts/SS_50.dgecounts.rds"))$umicount$inex$all))
reads_M42 <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(readRDS(here("data/RTase/counts/Maxima_42.dgecounts.rds"))$readcount$inex$all))
reads_M50 <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(readRDS(here("data/RTase/counts/Maxima_50.dgecounts.rds"))$readcount$inex$all))
reads_S42 <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(readRDS(here("data/RTase/counts/SS_42.dgecounts.rds"))$readcount$inex$all))
reads_S50 <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(readRDS(here("data/RTase/counts/SS_50.dgecounts.rds"))$readcount$inex$all))

# Calculate UMIs per Read for each column (replicate) in each condition
umi_read_list <- list(
  M42 = data.frame(
    sample = colnames(umis_M42),
    condition = "M42",
    total_umis = colSums(umis_M42),
    total_reads = colSums(reads_M42)
  ),
  M50 = data.frame(
    sample = colnames(umis_M50),
    condition = "M50",
    total_umis = colSums(umis_M50),
    total_reads = colSums(reads_M50)
  ),
  S42 = data.frame(
    sample = colnames(umis_S42),
    condition = "S42",
    total_umis = colSums(umis_S42),
    total_reads = colSums(reads_S42)
  ),
  S50 = data.frame(
    sample = colnames(umis_S50),
    condition = "S50",
    total_umis = colSums(umis_S50),
    total_reads = colSums(reads_S50)
  )
)

# Combine all conditions into one dataframe and calculate UMIs per read for each sample/column
umi_read_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(umi_read_list) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(umis_per_read = total_umis / total_reads)

umi_read_df
```

```{r umi_per_read_plot}
# Create factor with proper ordering for conditions
umi_read_df_plot <- umi_read_df %>%

  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0),

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90")

    x = "Condition",

plot_umi_per_read
```

```{r config}
# Parameters
out_dir <- "/data/share/htp/prime-seq_NextGen/data/RTase/bam_downsample_duplication_out"

seed <- 29836492
min_reads_per_barcode <- 10000
sort_mem <- "100G"
mode <- "inex"  # "exon" = GE only; "inex" = GE if present else GI

# BAM tags
CELL_TAG <- "BC"
UMI_TAG <- "UB"
GENE_EXON_TAG <- "GE"
GENE_INTRON_TAG <- "GI"

# Create output directories
```

# Helper Functions

```{r functions}
# Check required tools
check_tool <- function(tool) {
  p <- Sys.which(tool)
  if (p == "") stop("Required tool not found in PATH: ", tool)
  p
}
check_tool("bash")
check_tool("samtools")
check_tool("awk")
check_tool("sort")

# Compression commands
compress_cmd <- if (Sys.which("pigz") != "") sprintf("pigz -p %d -c", threads) else "gzip -c"
decompress_cmd <- if (Sys.which("pigz") != "") "pigz -dc" else "gzip -dc"

# Execute bash command
run_bash <- function(cmd) {
  full <- paste("bash -lc", shQuote(paste0("set -euo pipefail; ", cmd)))
  message("\n$ ", full)
  out <- suppressWarnings(system(full, intern = TRUE))
  st <- attr(out, "status")
  if (!is.null(st) && st != 0) stop("Command failed (exit ", st, ").\n", paste(out, collapse = "\n"))
  out
}

# Count assigned reads (BC+UB+gene tags)
count_assigned_reads <- function(bam, mode = c("inex","exon")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  if (mode == "exon") {
    cmd <- sprintf(
      "samtools view -F 2308 %s | awk '{
         bc=0; ub=0; ge=0;
         for(i=12;i<=NF;i++){
           if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) bc=1;
           else if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) ub=1;
           else if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) ge=1;
         }
         if(bc && ub && ge) c++;
       } END {print c+0}'",
      shQuote(bam), CELL_TAG, UMI_TAG, GENE_EXON_TAG
    )
  } else {
    cmd <- sprintf(
      "samtools view -F 2308 %s | awk '{
         bc=0; ub=0; ge=0; gi=0;
         for(i=12;i<=NF;i++){
           if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) bc=1;
           else if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) ub=1;
           else if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) ge=1;
           else if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) gi=1;
         }
         if(bc && ub && (ge || gi)) c++;
       } END {print c+0}'",
      shQuote(bam), CELL_TAG, UMI_TAG, GENE_EXON_TAG, GENE_INTRON_TAG
    )
  }
  as.numeric(run_bash(cmd)[1])
}

# Downsample BAM to target fraction
downsample_bam_if_needed <- function(in_bam, out_bam, frac, seed = 42, threads = 4) {
  if (frac >= 0.999999) return(in_bam)
  s_arg <- sprintf("%d.%06d", seed, as.integer(round(frac * 1e6)))
  cmd <- sprintf("samtools view -h -b -s %s %s > %s",
                 s_arg, shQuote(in_bam), shQuote(out_bam))
  run_bash(cmd)
  run_bash(sprintf("samtools index -@ %d %s", threads, shQuote(out_bam)))
  out_bam
}

# Extract BC, gene, UMI tags to TSV
extract_tags_to_tsv_gz <- function(bam, out_tsv_gz, mode = c("inex","exon")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  if (mode == "exon") {
    cmd <- sprintf(
      "samtools view -F 2308 %s | awk 'BEGIN{OFS=\"\\t\"} {
         bc=\"\"; ub=\"\"; ge=\"\";
         for(i=12;i<=NF;i++){
           if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) bc=substr($i,6);
           else if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) ub=substr($i,6);
           else if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) ge=substr($i,6);
         }
         if(bc!=\"\" && ub!=\"\" && ge!=\"\") print bc, ge, ub;
       }' | %s > %s",
      shQuote(bam), CELL_TAG, UMI_TAG, GENE_EXON_TAG, compress_cmd, shQuote(out_tsv_gz)
    )
  } else {
    cmd <- sprintf(
      "samtools view -F 2308 %s | awk 'BEGIN{OFS=\"\\t\"} {
         bc=\"\"; ub=\"\"; ge=\"\"; gi=\"\";
         for(i=12;i<=NF;i++){
           if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) bc=substr($i,6);
           else if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) ub=substr($i,6);
           else if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) ge=substr($i,6);
           else if(index($i, \"%s:Z:\")==1) gi=substr($i,6);
         }
         gene=(ge!=\"\") ? ge : gi;
         if(bc!=\"\" && ub!=\"\" && gene!=\"\") print bc, gene, ub;
       }' | %s > %s",
      shQuote(bam), CELL_TAG, UMI_TAG, GENE_EXON_TAG, GENE_INTRON_TAG, compress_cmd, shQuote(out_tsv_gz)
    )
  }
  run_bash(cmd)
  invisible(out_tsv_gz)
}

# Count total reads per barcode
count_reads_per_barcode <- function(tsv_gz, out_counts_tsv) {
  cmd <- sprintf(
    "%s %s | awk -F'\\t' '{c[$1]++} END{for(b in c) print b\"\\t\"c[b]}' > %s",
    decompress_cmd, shQuote(tsv_gz), shQuote(out_counts_tsv)
  )
  run_bash(cmd)
  invisible(out_counts_tsv)
}

# Count unique (gene, UMI) pairs per barcode
count_unique_gene_umi_per_barcode <- function(tsv_gz, out_counts_tsv, tmp_dir, sort_mem) {
  cmd <- sprintf(
    "%s %s | LC_ALL=C sort -u -S %s -T %s | awk -F'\\t' '{c[$1]++} END{for(b in c) print b\"\\t\"c[b]}' > %s",
    decompress_cmd, shQuote(tsv_gz), sort_mem, shQuote(tmp_dir), shQuote(out_counts_tsv)
  )
  run_bash(cmd)
  invisible(out_counts_tsv)
}

# Read counts file
read_counts_file <- function(path, colname) {
  x <- read.delim(path, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(x) <- c("barcode", colname)
  x
}
```

# Analysis

```{r analysis}
stopifnot(all(file.exists(bam_tbl$bam)))

# Count assigned reads and determine downsampling fractions
bam_tbl$assigned_reads <- vapply(bam_tbl$bam, count_assigned_reads, numeric(1), mode = mode)
if (any(bam_tbl$assigned_reads <= 0)) {
  stop("Some BAM has 0 assigned reads in this mode; check tags / BAM choice.")
}
R_target <- min(bam_tbl$assigned_reads)
bam_tbl <- bam_tbl %>% mutate(frac = pmin(1, R_target / assigned_reads))

# Process each condition
all_per_bc <- list()
actual_assigned_after <- numeric(nrow(bam_tbl))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(bam_tbl))) {
  cond <- bam_tbl$condition[i]
  bam <- bam_tbl$bam[i]
  frac <- bam_tbl$frac[i]
  
  message("Processing: ", cond)
  
  # Downsample if needed
  ds_bam <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(cond, ".downsampled.bam"))
  bam_used <- downsample_bam_if_needed(bam, ds_bam, frac, seed = seed, threads = threads)
  
  # Extract tags and count reads/UMIs
  tsv_gz <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(cond, ".", mode, ".barcode_gene_umi.tsv.gz"))
  reads_bc <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(cond, ".", mode, ".reads_per_barcode.tsv"))
  umis_bc <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(cond, ".", mode, ".umis_per_barcode.tsv"))
  
  extract_tags_to_tsv_gz(bam_used, tsv_gz, mode = mode)
  count_reads_per_barcode(tsv_gz, reads_bc)
  count_unique_gene_umi_per_barcode(tsv_gz, umis_bc, tmp_dir = tmp_dir, sort_mem = sort_mem)
  
  # Calculate metrics
  r <- read_counts_file(reads_bc, "reads")
  u <- read_counts_file(umis_bc, "umis")
  
  per_bc <- r %>%
    left_join(u, by = "barcode") %>%
    mutate(
      umis = ifelse(is.na(umis), 0L, umis),
      umi_per_read = umis / reads,
      dup_rate = 1 - umi_per_read,
      condition = cond
    )
  
  actual_assigned_after[i] <- sum(per_bc$reads, na.rm = TRUE)
  all_per_bc[[cond]] <- per_bc
}

bam_tbl$assigned_reads_after_downsample <- actual_assigned_after
```

# Summarize Results

```{r summarize}
per_sample <- bind_rows(all_per_bc) %>%
  mutate(
    RTase = ifelse(grepl("^Maxima", condition), "Maxima H-", "Superscript IV"),
    RT_temp = ifelse(grepl("_42$", condition), "42 °C", "50 °C")
  ) %>%
  filter(reads >= min_reads_per_barcode)

per_condition <- per_sample %>%
  group_by(condition, RTase, RT_temp) %>%
  summarise(
    n_barcodes = n(),
    median_reads = median(reads),
    median_umis = median(umis),
    median_umi_per_read = median(umi_per_read),
    median_dup_rate = median(dup_rate),
    mean_dup_rate = mean(dup_rate),
    sd_dup_rate = sd(dup_rate),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(per_sample, 
          file.path(out_dir, paste0("per_barcode_duplication_downsampled_", mode, ".csv")), 
          row.names = FALSE)
```
